safetyWarning.title: Important Safety Warning
safetyWarning.content: This Service uses a machine learning model for mushroom identification, but it is not 100% reliable. Many mushrooms look similar, and misidentification can result in severe poisoning or death. Do not rely on this Service to determine if a mushroom is safe to eat. Always consult a professional mycologist or a local expert before consuming or handling wild mushrooms.

useOfService.title: Use of the Service
useOfService.content: The Service provides information about wild edibles conditions based on various factors. The information is for general guidance only and is not guaranteed to be accurate, complete, or up-to-date.

foragingDisclaimer.title: Foraging Disclaimer
foragingDisclaimer.content: The Service includes recipes and information about wild edible plants, berries, nuts, and mushrooms. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, the safe consumption of wild edibles depends entirely on correct identification, appropriate preparation, and individual health conditions.
foragingDisclaimer.misidentification: Misidentification of wild plants or fungi can lead to allergic reactions, poisoning, or other serious health consequences. Some edible species have toxic lookalikes. Always consult a local expert or use an authoritative guide when identifying wild edibles, and do not consume anything unless you are 100% certain of its safety.
foragingDisclaimer.preparation: Additionally, some wild edibles should only be consumed in small quantities or after specific preparation methods to neutralize naturally occurring compounds. Recipes provided by the Service are for educational purposes and assume correct identification and proper handling of ingredients.

disclaimer.predictions: A variety of fungi and fruits grow in the wild, and some may be toxic or harmful if misidentified. The predictions provided by this Service are generated by a machine learning model and should be considered only as an advisory tool. This model is not perfect and may produce incorrect classifications. Misidentifying mushrooms can lead to severe poisoning or death. Always consult a qualified expert before consuming or handling any fungi or fruits.
